introduction.content: This Privacy Policy explains how Xernerx Studios ("we", "our", "us") collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you use our websites, dashboards, Discord bots, APIs, CDN, and desktop applications.

account.title: Account & Device Session Information:
account.desc: When you sign in via Discord OAuth2 or our QR Code / 6-character Pairing Code Device Sign-In flow, we collect your Discord ID, username, avatar, email address, custom profile settings (display name, bio, pronouns, banner), and recent device session metadata (browser, operating system, device type, and last-active timestamp for up to 10 devices) so you can review and manage active sessions.

We immediately discard OAuth access tokens after verifying your identity.

developers.title: For API & Bot Developers:
developers.desc: Scoped Bearer API tokens, webhook URLs, application and organization metadata, real-time WebSocket gateway telemetry, and configuration settings used to operate your integrations on our infrastructure.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: This Cookie Policy explains how Xernerx Studios ("we", "our", or "us") uses cookies, local storage, session partitions, and similar technologies when you visit or interact with our websites, dashboards, APIs, and desktop applications.

whatAreCookies.title: 2. What Are Cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your web browser when you visit a website. They allow the platform to recognize your device, maintain your authenticated session seamlessly across all Xernerx subdomains (*.xernerx.com), and remember your customized interface preferences.

essential.title: Essential Cookies:
essential.desc: Strictly necessary for the core operation and security of our services. These include Discord OAuth2 authentication sessions, CSRF protection, secondary account-linking state verification, and your saved cookie consent state. Because the platform cannot function securely without them, they cannot be disabled.

functional.title: Functional Cookies:
functional.desc: Used to remember your personal preferences across subdomains, including your selected language, interface theme (dark, light, or system), accent color, layout density, UI zoom, typography scale, and header/sidebar workspace toggles.

analytics.title: Analytics Cookies:
analytics.desc: Help us understand how visitors interact with our websites, monitor platform performance, and diagnose technical errors so we can improve reliability.

marketing.title: Marketing & Advertising Cookies:
marketing.desc: Used by third-party advertising partners (such as Google AdSense) to deliver relevant advertisements and measure campaign effectiveness.

cookiesUsed.title: 4. Specific Cookies We Set
cookiesUsed.content: Across the Xernerx ecosystem (.xernerx.com), we set and read the following first-party cookies:

auth.title: Authentication & OAuth State (__Secure-next-auth.session-token, __Secure-next-auth.csrf-token, __Secure-next-auth.callback-url, __Secure-next-auth.state, __xernerx_conn_oauth):
auth.desc: Essential HTTP-only secure cookies managed by NextAuth to authenticate your session across subdomains, prevent cross-site request forgery, and verify short-lived (10-minute) PKCE/OAuth state when linking third-party accounts on account.xernerx.com.

consent.title: Cookie Consent (xernerx-cookie-consent):
consent.desc: An essential cookie that stores your chosen cookie category preferences (essential, functional, analytics, marketing) and an agreedAt timestamp for up to 1 year. If we publish a material update to this Cookie Policy, the agreedAt timestamp is compared against the latest policy version so we can re-prompt you.

locale.title: Localization (NEXT_LOCALE):
locale.desc: A functional cookie that remembers your preferred interface language across all Xernerx subdomains for up to 1 year.

appearance.title: Interface, Appearance & Workspace Preferences (theme, accent, uiZoom, uiGap, textScale, clientSync, syncFromDiscord, pref_*):
appearance.desc: Functional cookies (including pref_showHeaderStore, pref_showHeaderCommandPalette, pref_showHeaderNotifications, pref_showHeaderDownload, pref_showHeaderAppDrawer, pref_showShortcutHints, pref_showDiscordCollectibles, pref_showGiftBadge, pref_reducedMotion, pref_defaultSidebarCollapsed, and pref_developerMode) that preserve your visual and workspace customizations so the server can render your layout immediately without visual flickering.

localStorage.title: 5. Local Storage & Desktop Client Storage
localStorage.content: In addition to browser cookies, we use browser localStorage (including theme, accent, uiZoom, uiGap, textScale, pref_*, and xernerx_sidebar_view_* keys) to cache non-sensitive interface state locally for instant startup. In the Xernerx Desktop App (Electron), local configuration is stored in metadata.json and each account slot uses an isolated Chromium session partition (persist:xernerx and persist:xernerx-<slot>) so you can switch between multiple accounts safely.

thirdParty.title: 6. Third-Party Cookies
thirdParty.content: Some features integrate with third-party services, including Discord (for primary authentication), Stripe (for secure checkout, billing portals, and fraud prevention), Google AdSense (for displaying advertisements when consented), and optional connected account providers (GitHub, Twitch, Google/YouTube, X/Twitter, Spotify, Steam, and Reddit) when you initiate account linking. These third parties may set their own cookies in accordance with their respective policies.

managing.title: 7. Managing Your Preferences
managing.content: You can review or update your cookie consent choices at any time by clicking "Cookie Preferences" in the website footer to reopen the preferences manager. You may also configure your web browser to block or delete cookies, though blocking essential cookies will prevent you from signing in or using authenticated features.

changes.title: 8. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our technology, infrastructure, or legal requirements. When updated, we bump our policy version date so visitors are prompted to review their cookie preferences.

sync.title: Seamless Theme & Account Sync

scale.title: Built for Scale
scale.description: Our infrastructure and tools are designed from the ground up to handle massive communities and workloads effortlessly. High-availability services and automated load balancing keep your applications responsive at any size.

opensource.title: Open Source Heart
opensource.description: We believe in transparent development. Our software tools, modular frameworks, and developer utilities are freely available so builders everywhere can inspect, extend, and push the ecosystem forward.

design.title: User-Centric Design
design.description: Whether it is a CLI tool or a web dashboard, we prioritize intuitive interfaces and seamless developer experiences. Every workflow is crafted for clarity, speed, and accessibility across all devices.

timeline.description: From early experimentation with bots to stable infrastructure engineering, see how Xernerx Studios evolved over the years into a unified platform for developers and communities.

0.title: Amethyst Development Founded
0.description: Thomas, Johannes, and Asher established Amethyst Development with a focus on scalable Discord tooling. The team set out to build reliable community utilities and modular bot foundations.

1.title: Rebranded to Portal Development
1.description: Following structural changes, the company was reintroduced under the name Portal Development. This milestone unified our early Discord projects under a shared engineering roadmap.

2.title: First Bot Acquisition
2.description: Roblox Utilities joined the portfolio, expanding our reach into multi-server utility tooling. The integration brought thousands of active community servers onto our core infrastructure.

3.title: To-Do List Bot Launched
3.description: Clari began development of To-Do List Bot, introducing structured productivity features for Discord servers. Communities gained personal task lists, shared channel boards, and automated reminders.

4.title: Discord-Translate Begins
4.description: Thomas initiated development of Discord-Translate, focused on connecting multilingual communities. The project enabled seamless cross-language conversations inside international Discord guilds.

5.title: Acquired DragDev Studios
5.description: DragDev Studios and YourApps joined the company, along with three new developers. Their expertise accelerated our work on web dashboards and custom server application workflows.

6.title: Metamorphosis Rewrite
6.description: Discord-Translate was rebuilt from the ground up and relaunched as Metamorphosis with improved infrastructure. The rewrite introduced faster translation pipelines and automated role routing.

7.title: Leadership Transition
7.description: Johannes stepped down from daily operations. Infrastructure responsibilities and backend architecture were restructured internally to prepare for long-term platform scalability.

8.title: Zodiac Development
8.description: Max began development of Zodiac, expanding our catalog into astrology and personality tooling. Social communities quickly adopted Zodiac for daily horoscopes and interactive birth chart insights.

9.title: Xernerx Studios Rebrand
9.description: The company rebranded to Xernerx Studios, reflecting a major evolution in focus and identity. We launched the unified Xernerx Suite monorepo, open JSON REST API, and open-source developer packages.

10.title: Today
10.description: You're all caught up! Today Xernerx Studios continues to ship modern software, Discord bots like Virtue, Metamorphosis, and Zodiac, and open-source developer tools for communities worldwide.

personalization.title: Personalization & Global Localization
personalization.description: Tailor every interface to match your style. Switch between dark, light, and system themes, pick custom accent colors, and adjust UI zoom and layout density. You can sync your appearance directly from Discord and browse in your preferred language through community-driven translations.

Third-party integrations use scoped tokens, user data is never sold to advertisers, and your account settings give you one-click controls to manage profile visibility, reset data, or delete your account anytime.

card1.title: How is the Xernerx Suite organized across its 9 subdomains?
card1.description: The Xernerx Suite is a unified multi-application ecosystem where a single Discord sign-in, your theme & scaling preferences, and your notifications carry seamlessly across 9 specialized subdomains:

card2.title: How do the Command Palette (Ctrl + K), App Drawer (Ctrl + Space), and URL Omnibar (Ctrl + .) work?
card2.description: You can navigate across the entire suite without touching your mouse: (1) Press Ctrl + K to focus the current page's search bar, or press Ctrl + Shift + K (or Ctrl + K when no page search bar is mounted) to open the global Command Palette—which searches current page views, quick actions (theme toggle, sidebar toggle, copy URL), suite apps, account settings, live public bots and servers, and community issues/suggestions/roadmap items; (2) Press Ctrl + Space (or Alt + A) to open the App Drawer grid and launch any Xernerx subdomain; (3) Press Ctrl + . to open the URL Omnibar in the header, allowing you to switch subdomains, switch between Public/Canary/Dev environments, and type a custom path in one bar. Click any button below to test them live:

card3.title: What global keyboard shortcuts are available across all Xernerx web apps?
card3.description: Every application in the suite supports these global shortcuts: Ctrl + / opens the Keyboard Shortcuts & Changelog modal; Ctrl + K focuses page search or opens the Command Palette (Ctrl + Shift + K forces the Command Palette); Ctrl + Space or Alt + A opens the App Drawer; Ctrl + B collapses or expands the Sidebar; Ctrl + . toggles the URL Omnibar; Ctrl + I opens the Notifications drawer; Ctrl + , jumps straight to Account Settings (account.xernerx.com); Ctrl + S or Ctrl + Enter saves unsaved form changes (and Alt + R resets unsaved changes); Alt + 1..9 switches between sidebar views or tabs; Ctrl + Shift + C copies the current suite URL (automatically preserving your active ?view= parameter); Ctrl + R reloads application state; and Esc closes any open modal, popover, or drawer.

card4.title: What official vanity URLs and quick redirects can I use?
card4.description: Across every Xernerx subdomain, /support and /discord redirect to our official Discord Support Server, /github opens github.com/xernerx, and /npm opens our npm package suite. On xernerx.com, use /invite or /invite/[slug] for bot invites, /desktop for the Desktop App download page, and /careers or /jobs for open team applications. On info.xernerx.com, use /bugs for the Issue Tracker (/issues) and /help for the FAQ (/faq). On app.xernerx.com, use /orgs or /organizations for the Developer Portal (/portal) and /leaderboards for /leaderboard. On account.xernerx.com, every settings tab has a clean vanity path: /profile, /activity, /connections, /devices, /appearance, /preferences, /language, /notifications, /billing, /tokens, and /media.

card5.title: How does the floating Support Button work, and how can I contact specific departments?
card5.description: Clicking the floating Support button in the bottom-right corner of any page opens a quick-help popover with links to the Support Hub, Report an Issue, Suggest a Feature, and FAQ, plus a Join Support Server button. If you are signed in and not yet a member of our Discord server, clicking Join Support Server uses your authorized Discord guilds.join scope to add your account to the official Xernerx Support server automatically and open the support channel. For direct email inquiries, visit xernerx.com/contact to reach General Inquiries (info@xernerx.com), Technical Support (support@xernerx.com), Billing & Invoices (invoice@xernerx.com), Security Disclosures (security@xernerx.com), or Legal & Privacy (legal@xernerx.com).

card6.title: How do Custom Vanity Slugs work for Bots, Servers, and Users?
card6.description: Custom Vanity Slugs let you replace long Discord snowflake IDs with clean, memorable URLs across the suite—such as app.xernerx.com/bots/virtue, app.xernerx.com/servers/xernerx, and app.xernerx.com/users/alex. Vanity slugs can be unlocked via the Credit Store or supporter perks and configured directly in your Profile Settings, Server Dashboard, or Developer Portal.

card.title: What are the Release, Canary, and Dev environments?
card.description: Within Xernerx Studios we operate 3 isolated environments across all 9 suite subdomains (www, app, account, api, cdn, docs, info, store, and admin). Here is what each environment is used for:

release.label: Release
release.description: The stable production environment (*.xernerx.com) used for general availability.

canary.label: Canary
canary.description: The public staging and beta environment (*.canary.xernerx.com) where new features and merged translations arrive first.

dev.label: Dev
dev.description: The internal development environment (*.dev.xernerx.com) used for active building and local service orchestration.

card2.title: How can I monitor live uptime, service latency, and active incidents?
card2.description: Visit info.xernerx.com/status to inspect real-time operational health and response latency across all 9 Xernerx Suite services, view verified active incidents from the issue tracker, or click Status Badge to embed our live SVG status shield (api.xernerx.com/v1/status/badge.svg) in your README or website.

card3.title: Where can I read release notes, changelogs, or subscribe via RSS?
card3.description: Every Xernerx Suite web app exposes CORS-enabled GET /api/version and GET /api/changelog endpoints and automatically notifies you with an App Updated toast when a new version is deployed. You can press Ctrl + / anywhere to open the Changelog & Shortcuts modal, browse full version histories with direct version deep-links on info.xernerx.com/changelog, or subscribe to our RSS 2.0 feed at api.xernerx.com/v1/changelog/rss.

card4.title: How does the Issue & Bug Tracker (info.xernerx.com/issues) work, and what do the release badges mean?
card4.description: On info.xernerx.com/issues (or vanity URL info.xernerx.com/bugs), you can filter reports by All Open, Verified (acknowledged by engineers), Unverified (community submitted), or Pending Release, and attach up to 10MB screenshots or logs (PNG, JPG, GIF, WEBP, TXT, LOG, JSON) via drag-and-drop or Ctrl + V paste. When our engineers link a fix to a target app version, the issue card displays a live deployment badge: Queued • app vX.Y.Z (awaiting build), Canary Only • app vX.Y.Z (live on *.canary.xernerx.com), or Live (Prod & Canary) • app vX.Y.Z once rolled out to Production.

card5.title: What official vanity links and quick redirects are available across the suite?
card5.description: You can use clean vanity routes on any Xernerx domain: /support and /discord open our official Discord community, /github opens our GitHub organization, and /npm opens our npm package suite. On xernerx.com you can use /invite (or /invite/[slug]), /desktop (for /download), and /careers or /jobs (for /applications). On info.xernerx.com you can use /bugs (for /issues) and /help (for /faq). On account.xernerx.com every settings tab has a direct vanity path (/profile, /activity, /connections, /devices, /appearance, /preferences, /language, /notifications, /billing, /tokens, and /media).

card6.title: How do the Suggestion Centre (/suggestions) and Platform Roadmap (/roadmap) work?
card6.description: In the Suggestion Centre (info.xernerx.com/suggestions), you can filter ideas by product, sort by Most Upvoted, Newest, or Upvoted by Me, and submit new feature ideas (with real-time duplicate detection as you type). Popular suggestions are promoted by staff to the Platform Roadmap (info.xernerx.com/roadmap), which tracks milestones across Idea, Planned, In Progress, and Released stages alongside live Avg Issue Resolution Time metrics and the Known Issues Tracker. Click Notify Me (Watching) on any roadmap milestone to receive an automatic notification the moment it is released.

card1.title: What is the Xernerx Desktop App and how do I switch between Stable and Canary channels?
card1.description: The Xernerx Desktop App (xernerx.com/download or xernerx.com/desktop) is our native Electron companion client for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It wraps the Xernerx workspace in a clean borderless window with automatic background updates and native OS integration. When visiting the download page on Canary or Dev environments, you can toggle between the Stable release channel and the Canary build channel.

card2.title: How does the 1-Click Multi-Account Switcher work in the Desktop App?
card2.description: Unlike a standard browser where signing into an alt Discord account logs out your main account, the Xernerx Desktop App isolates each account slot in its own dedicated Chromium session partition (persist:xernerx and persist:xernerx-<slot>) stored in your local metadata.json configuration. Open your user card in the sidebar to add an account slot or swap between multiple signed-in Discord accounts in one click.

card3.title: What is the Always-on-Top Live Overlay Monitor (app.xernerx.com/overlay)?
card3.description: The Live Overlay Monitor (launched from your sidebar user card or at app.xernerx.com/overlay) is a compact, game-friendly companion view designed to be pinned on top of fullscreen applications and games. It displays real-time API latency (in ms) and operational health, a Live Feed tab of recent events and notifications, a Servers & Bots quick-status tab, and Quick Actions to open routes in your main window.

card4.title: How do Native Notifications, Streamer Protection, Quick Capture to CDN, and Desktop Hotkeys work?
card4.description: When running the Desktop App, a dedicated Desktop Client section appears in account.xernerx.com/preferences. From there you can choose your default Startup Location (Dashboard, Developer Portal, Account, Explore, Store, Docs, CDN, etc.), toggle Native OS Notifications (Windows Action Center toasts, Apple Notification Center banners, taskbar flashes, and macOS Dock unread badges), Streamer Protection (using native OS win.setContentProtection to hide your window from OBS and screen recorders), Smart Battery Saver & Wake Sync (throttling background canvas animations on battery power and resyncing on wake), Discord Rich Presence (RPC), the global Ctrl + Shift + X summon hotkey, and optional global hotkeys for the Spotlight Quick Launcher (Ctrl + Shift + Space, off by default to avoid app conflicts) and Quick Screen Capture to CDN (Ctrl + Shift + S).

card5.title: How can I use Taskbar JumpLists, inspect Desktop App logs, edit raw metadata.json, or clear the app cache?
card5.description: Right-clicking the Xernerx icon on your Windows Taskbar or macOS Dock gives you direct JumpList and Dock shortcuts to open your Dashboard, Developer Portal, Live Overlay, or trigger an instant Screen Capture to your Xernerx CDN media library. Inside account.xernerx.com/preferences, you can also switch the Desktop Client panel into raw JSON Editor mode to edit your local metadata.json flags directly, open the Desktop Logs Modal to inspect or copy diagnostic runtime logs, or click Clear Cache to purge cached Chromium assets.

card1.title: How do I become a translator?
card1.p1: Sign in on account.xernerx.com, open Language preferences (/language or /?tab=language), and select any language with less than 100% translation coverage to reveal the Contribute card (or select + Contribute a translation from the dropdown).
card1.p2: Make sure you are logged in with your Discord account before submitting your translator request.

card2.title: How does the Translation Studio work once my application is approved?
card2.description: Translator applications are reviewed by staff on admin.xernerx.com. Once approved, you immediately unlock the Translation Studio on admin.xernerx.com/?tab=translations, where you can translate missing keys one by one in the distraction-free New Entries card flow, search and refine existing translations in Review Existing mode against the English (UK) (en-GB) source of truth, or export dictionary JSON.

card3.title: I translated but it didn't update on the live site immediately?
card3.description: When you click Push to review in the Translation Studio, your changes are committed to the dictionary branch and automatically merged into the canary branch without requiring manual admin approval. The Translation Studio loads language JSON files directly from the Canary branch, stores the Canary version your translation was submitted against, and locks the submit button until the Canary version updates and the Canary build finishes and passes.

card4.title: My language is not included in the list—how can I request it?
card4.description: Join our official Discord server via /support (or submit a request in the Suggestion Centre on info.xernerx.com/suggestions) and let our team know which language locale you would like to translate. Once we initialize the base locale file, you can start translating right away in the Translation Studio.

card5.title: How does language detection and cross-subdomain syncing work?
card5.description: Your selected interface language is saved in the first-party NEXT_LOCALE cookie across all *.xernerx.com subdomains and synced to your account profile so every web app and the Desktop Client render in your language automatically. Your Language settings page also displays a read-only indicator of the locale currently reported by your Discord account.

card.title: How is the Estimated Value calculated on Bot and Organization profiles?
card.description1: The Estimated Value metric displayed on bot and organization profiles is a purely statistical estimation of "Audience & Reach Value". It is designed to gamify community reach and measure the scale of a bot's attention economy.
card.disclaimer: ⚠️ Disclaimer: This valuation does NOT track, represent, or account for any actual financial income, subscription revenue, or server hosting expenses on the developer's end.
card.description2: The formula combines a static baseline and a dynamic 30-day growth velocity multiplier:
card.baseline: Baseline: Calculated by assigning a flat baseline weight to current active servers and total user reach.
card.multiplier: Momentum Multiplier: Compares current baseline metrics against the bot's baseline 30 days prior. Rapidly growing bots receive a growth multiplier (up to 3.0x), while bots losing active reach receive a proportional discount.

card2.title: How do I register a Discord bot and bind an API token?
card2.description: Go to account.xernerx.com/tokens (/?tab=tokens) and create a new API token (prefixed with xrx_), which starts in a pending state. Use that token with your bot via @xernerx/stats, @xernerx/framework, or any POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE request to https://api.xernerx.com/v1/bots/[id]/* (such as /stats, /commands, /profile, or /releases). On its first mutation request, the token automatically binds to your bot and user account—transitioning to active and scoping the token to that bot—while simultaneously creating your bot's profile from Discord so you can customize descriptions, links, webhooks, and slash commands in the Developer Portal on app.xernerx.com/portal.

card3.title: Where can I find official pre-configured Discord bot invite links?
card3.description: Visit xernerx.com/invites (or use vanity links such as xernerx.com/invite/[slug]) to browse and copy official OAuth2 invite links for verified Xernerx applications—including Virtue, Metamorphosis, Zodiac, and To-Do—pre-configured with the exact Discord permissions each bot requires.

card4.title: How do Bot Webhooks and live Test Pings work?
card4.description: In the Developer Portal (app.xernerx.com/portal/bots/[id]) under the Webhooks tab, you can register any HTTPS webhook endpoint or Discord Webhook URL (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...) and toggle any of the 8 supported event triggers: POST vote, POST stat, PATCH stat, DELETE stat, POST review, PATCH review, DELETE review, and VOTE review. Click Test Ping at any time to send a live test payload (POST /secure/bots/[id]/hooks/test) and inspect the HTTP status code and round-trip latency in milliseconds.

card5.title: How do Bot and Server voting, 12-hour cooldowns, and the Ecosystem Leaderboards work?
card5.description: Any signed-in user can vote for a public Discord bot (app.xernerx.com/bots/[id]) or server (app.xernerx.com/servers/[id]) once every 12 hours. Every vote immediately records a new point on the historical statistics graph, fires subscribed POST vote webhooks, and rewards the voter with +100 Credits. Visit app.xernerx.com/leaderboard (or /leaderboards) to explore top rankings across three tabs: Top Bots (sorted by Votes, Users, or Servers), Top Servers (sorted by Votes or Members), and Daily Streaks (ranking users by Streak, Credits, Total Community Impact, Bugs reported, and Suggestions submitted).

card6.title: How do I manage my Discord server and configure the Virtue progression system?
card6.description: Open the Server Dashboard at app.xernerx.com/dashboard, which automatically lists every Discord server where you hold Administrator (0x8) or Manage Server (0x20) permissions. From there you can customize your public server listing, inspect historical member/message/boost/bot charts across 24h to All-Time timeframes, and open the Virtue tab (?tab=virtue) to configure XP curve difficulty (Easy, Casual, Balanced, Hard, Extreme), periodic reset cycles (Daily, Weekly, Monthly), tracked level roles, ignored roles, custom level-up messages ([@mention], [@level]), and auto-delete timers.

card7.title: How do Developer Organizations work?
card7.description: On app.xernerx.com/portal (or vanity link app.xernerx.com/orgs), click New Organization in the sidebar to group multiple bots, linked Discord servers, and team members under a shared public profile (app.xernerx.com/organization/[id]). Organization owners can invite members by Discord User ID (delivering an interactive in-app invitation), assign custom organization roles, and transfer bots or servers between Personal and Organization workspaces.

card8.title: How does Bot and Server Discovery work on app.xernerx.com?
card8.description: On app.xernerx.com, you can toggle between Bots and Servers in the hero explorer, search by keyword or tag, and browse algorithmic discovery categories including Top Voted, Newly Added, Staff Picks, Promoted, Biggest on Platform, Biggest Communities, and Newcomers. Each bot or server card displays live server/member counts, vote totals, verification badges, and short descriptions.

card9.title: How do Slash Command syncing and interactive command search work on Bot profiles?
card9.description: Bot developers can publish their Discord slash commands either manually in app.xernerx.com/portal/bots/[id] under the Commands tab or automatically on bot startup via PUT https://api.xernerx.com/v1/bots/[id]/commands (which performs a clean bulk sync of your command array and required/optional parameters). Visitors viewing your public bot profile on app.xernerx.com/bots/[id] can open the Commands tab to search commands and parameters in real time and click any command pill to copy /command-name to their clipboard.

card10.title: How do Bot Reviews, Star Ratings, and Developer Responses work?
card10.description: On any public bot profile (app.xernerx.com/bots/[id]) under the Reviews tab, signed-in users can submit a 1-to-5 star rating with an optional written review, edit or delete their review, and mark other community reviews as helpful. Visitors can filter reviews by star rating (1★ to 5★) or sort by Most Helpful, Newest, Highest Rated, and Lowest Rated. Verified owners of the bot can post an official Developer Response directly underneath any review, and receive real-time webhook alerts via the POST review, PATCH review, DELETE review, and VOTE review webhook triggers.

card1.title: Who can access the Server Dashboard (app.xernerx.com/dashboard) and how does Server Sync work?
card1.description: When you open app.xernerx.com/dashboard, Xernerx queries your Discord guilds and automatically lists every server where you hold Administrator (0x8) or Manage Server (0x20) permissions in the sidebar (switchable with Alt + 1..9 or ?guild=[id]). The Server Sync Data banner indicates whether the Xernerx Bot is currently connected to the server (Bot Connected vs Bot Not Connected), whether the community is Verified, and the guild's active Discord locale.

card2.title: What server analytics and timeframes are tracked in the Server Dashboard?
card2.description: Once the Xernerx Bot is in your server, open the Stats tab (app.xernerx.com/dashboard?tab=stats) to inspect historical growth charts across four metrics: Members, Messages (30-minute intervals), Bots, and Server Boosts. You can filter the chart across 24 Hours (24h), 7 Days (7d), 30 Days (30d), 3 Months (3m), 6 Months (6m), 1 Year (1y), or All-Time (all).

card3.title: How does the Virtue Progression System (app.xernerx.com/dashboard?tab=virtue) work?
card3.description: Virtue is Xernerx's progression and engagement engine. Per-server text XP/levels/messages and voice XP/levels/time are tracked in the dedicated virtue database, while contributing to each user's unified global platform level in xernerx. In the Server Dashboard under the Virtue tab (?tab=virtue), server admins can configure: (1) Virtue Curve Mode—Easy (Very fast), Casual (Fast), Balanced (Standard), Hard (Slow curve), or Extreme (Prestige); (2) Automatic Reset Cycles—Daily, Weekly, or Monthly leaderboard wipes; (3) Tracked Level Roles (roles unlocked as members ascend) and Ignored Roles (exempt from earning score); and (4) Level-Up Announcements—toggleable channel embeds with a custom message template supporting [@mention] and [@level], a custom Announcement Channel ID, and an Auto-Delete timer in seconds.

card4.title: How do Developer Organizations (app.xernerx.com/portal) and Organization Roles work?
card4.description: In the Developer Portal (app.xernerx.com/portal or vanity route app.xernerx.com/orgs), click New Organization in the sidebar to create a shared team workspace with its own public profile (app.xernerx.com/organization/[id]). Inside an organization workspace you can upload a custom avatar and banner to the CDN, write a Markdown profile, create custom Organization Roles (Roles tab), invite team members by Discord User ID (who receive an interactive Accept/Decline notification in their Notifications drawer), feature an official Discord server, and view combined Est. Network Value, Total Servers, and Total Users across all published organization bots.

card5.title: How do I transfer a Bot or Server to an Organization, or reset/delete its data?
card5.description: Open the Settings tab of your bot (app.xernerx.com/portal/bots/[id]) or server (app.xernerx.com/dashboard?tab=settings). Under Transfer Organization, select any organization you own or belong to (or select Personal to move it back to your personal workspace) and save your changes. In the same Settings tab, you can also click Reset Data to clear all descriptions, external links, and widget toggles back to default without removing the listing, or click Delete to permanently purge the bot or server profile from Xernerx.

card6.title: How do Public User Profiles (app.xernerx.com/users/[id]), Discord Collectibles, and Badges work?
card6.description: Every user has a customizable profile at app.xernerx.com/users/[id] (editable on account.xernerx.com/profile). Public profiles showcase your Discord avatar, animated Discord Avatar Decorations and Collectibles Nameplates (toggleable via showDiscordCollectibles in account.xernerx.com/preferences), Clan badge, short bio, full Markdown Info, pronouns, timezone with UTC offset, Global Level, Daily Streak, Published Bots, Official Servers, Organizations, and automatic ecosystem badges including Bot Developer, Bug Hunter, and Contributor.

card7.title: How do Virtue Server XP & Voice Leaderboards work?
card7.description: When Virtue's leveling module is enabled on your Discord server, members automatically earn XP from text messages and active time in voice channels. Server owners can customize XP rates, level-up role rewards, and announcements in the Virtue Dashboard, while members can browse real-time ranked XP and Voice Leaderboards on your public server page.

card1.title: How do Discord OAuth2 sign-in and QR Code / 6-Character Device Pairing work?
card1.description: Xernerx Suite uses Discord OAuth2 as your primary identity across all *.xernerx.com subdomains (requesting profile, email, connections, guilds, and guilds.join scopes—clickable under About permissions on /login). When signing into the Xernerx Desktop App or a new browser, you can skip typing passwords or 2FA codes by scanning the login QR code with an already-authenticated phone or opening account.xernerx.com/devices (/?tab=devices) and entering the 6-character pairing code to approve the session instantly.

card2.title: How do Personal and Bot API Bearer Tokens work?
card2.description: On account.xernerx.com/tokens (/?tab=tokens), you can generate Bearer tokens (prefixed with xrx_). Newly created tokens start in a pending state; when first used with a bot on any POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE request to /v1/bots/[id]/* (such as /stats, /commands, /profile, or /releases), the token automatically creates the bot profile if needed, binds to that bot ID and your user account, transitions to active, and is scoped to GET requests and that bot's endpoints. Pass your token in the Authorization: Bearer <token> HTTP header when calling api.xernerx.com.

card3.title: How do Public, Limited, and Private privacy levels and Terms/Cookie consent prompts work?
card3.description: Every User, Bot, Server, Organization, and CDN Media item enforces our Universal 3-Tier Privacy Truth: Public (listed in public directories, explorers, leaderboards, and search; accessible by anyone), Limited (unlisted—never shown in public directories, search, or leaderboards, but accessible to anyone with the direct link or ID), and Private (strictly owner-only—never listed and blocked from viewing even with a direct link or ID unless you are the authenticated owner or authorized co-owner/member).

card4.title: How do Daily Credits and activity streaks work?
card4.description: You can claim daily credits once every 24 hours from account.xernerx.com/billing or your sidebar user card. Consecutive daily claims within the 48-hour grace window build your streak multiplier, which can be displayed on your public profile badge (/v1/users/[id]/badge.svg?type=streak) and the community leaderboard.

card5.title: How do I view and revoke active device sessions?
card5.description: Visit account.xernerx.com/devices (/?tab=devices) to view up to 10 active browser and Desktop App sessions with automatic OS (Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS) and browser detection, truncated session identifiers, and last-active timestamps. You can revoke any individual device in one click or use Log Out All Other Devices to terminate every session except your current one.

card6.title: Which secondary OAuth Connections are supported?
card6.description: On account.xernerx.com/connections (/?tab=connections), your Discord account is permanently linked as your Primary Identity. The Connections hub also includes secondary account integrations for GitHub, Twitch, YouTube, X (Twitter), Spotify, Steam, and Reddit (currently in preview while secondary OAuth linking workflows are being rolled out).

card7.title: How do Appearance themes, Discord accent sync, Dot-Matrix profiles, and custom UI scaling work?
card7.description: Open account.xernerx.com/appearance (/?tab=appearance) to switch between Dark, Light, and System themes, choose from 24 named preset accent colors (or Sync Accent from Discord), configure the ambient Dot-Matrix Background Profile (Default page-adaptive, Xernerx Wordmark, Xernerx Crest, Orbital Rings, Spiral Galaxy, Double Helix, Cyber Prism, Infinity Loop, Harmonic Wave Lattice, or Blank after loading) and Animation Mode (Animate by context, Static interactive-only, or Always Animate continuous ripple) that the loading matrix smoothly morphs into, and customize UI Zoom (--ui-scale), Layout Spacing (--ui-gap), and Text Scale (--text-scale).

card8.title: How does the Granular Notification Matrix work across In-App, Discord, and Email?
card8.description: On account.xernerx.com/notifications (/?tab=notifications), you can search alerts or use Enable Category / Mute Category across 6 categories—API (rate limit warnings, token created/revoked, downtime), Billing (invoice paid, subscription expiring, payment failed), Apps (bot approved/rejected), Community (roadmap released, issue/suggestion status updates, application reviewed), General (birthday), and Virtue (level-up)—across In-App, Discord DM, and Email channels. Community email notifications are free for all users, while transactional API, Billing, and Apps email alerts unlock with an active subscription.

card9.title: What Header and Workspace customization toggles are in Preferences (account.xernerx.com/preferences)?
card9.description: On account.xernerx.com/preferences (/?tab=preferences), you can declutter and tailor your workspace: (1) Header & Navigation Bar—individually show or hide the Store button, Command Palette button, Notifications bell, Desktop Download button, and App Drawer icon; and (2) Workspace, Profile & Motion—switch Global Sidebar Alignment between System, Left, or Right, and toggle Keyboard Shortcut Hints, Discord Collectibles (animated avatar decorations & nameplates), Daily Gift Badge indicator, Reduced Motion, Default Sidebar Collapsed, and Developer Mode.

card10.title: How do I view my Account Activity Log, export my GDPR JSON data, or reset/delete my account?
card10.description: Open account.xernerx.com/activity (/?tab=activity) to search and filter your submitted Applications, Issues, and Suggestions alongside their live status badges and staff review notes, or click Export Data to download a complete JSON archive (xernerx-account-data-[id]-[date].json) of your profile and submissions. To clear your bio and preferences without closing your account, or to permanently purge your account across the ecosystem, visit account.xernerx.com (/?tab=account).

card11.title: How do Profile Showcases and Vanity Badges work?
card11.description: Every user receives 1 free Profile Showcase slot in Account Settings -> Profile (account.xernerx.com/?tab=profile) to pin a custom card with a title, description, tag, cover image, and external link to their public profile (app.xernerx.com/users/[id]), with 1-click Quick-Fill from your Bots, Servers, Organizations, and linked OAuth Connections. You can unlock +1 or +3 additional permanent Showcase slots and collect Vanity Badges—including Dot-Matrix Architect (interactive dot-matrix profile banner), Credit Patron, High Roller, and Vault Sovereign—in the Credit Store.

card12.title: How can I download a copy of my personal data (.json)?
card12.description: You can export a complete, machine-readable .json archive of your Xernerx account at any time with 1-Click Personal Data Export in Account Settings. The archive includes your profile metadata, linked connections, preferences, credit ledger history, owned entities, and recent security activity logs.

card1.title: What plans and passes are available on the Xernerx Store?
card1.description: On store.xernerx.com, you can switch between Monthly (?interval=month) and Annual (?interval=year) billing across three catalog categories: (1) Bots, Servers & Ultra (?category=consumers), featuring the €0 Free Tier (consumer bots + 10 CDN uploads), the all-in-one Ultra Ecosystem master pass (unlocking Zodiac, Virtue, To-Do, and Metamorphosis user & server subscriptions, priority support, and 1,000 CDN uploads), and individual Zodiac, Virtue, To-Do, and Metamorphosis passes; (2) Developer API (?category=developers) featuring Developer Pro (advanced API access, extended rate limits, unlimited projects); and (3) Servers (?category=servers) for dedicated guild infrastructure.

card2.title: How do I manage or cancel subscriptions, and how does the Supporters showcase work?
card2.description: Visit account.xernerx.com/billing (/?tab=billing) or store.xernerx.com. On the Billing tab you can filter subscriptions by All, Active, or History, check renewal dates (including a 7-day expiring-soon badge), and cancel any active Stripe subscription in one click (POST /secure/store/[userId]/cancel). Team members with Staff Subscriptions enabled automatically receive an active infinite pass across all services. All users with an active subscription or Staff Subscription are celebrated on the Community Supporters page at app.xernerx.com/supporters.

card3.title: How do the Daily Credit Gift, 48-hour streak grace window, and voting rewards work?
card3.description: Claim your Daily Gift every 24h for 50 base Credits + streak bonuses (up to +100) + a +100 Milestone Bonus every 7th day, protected by up to 3 Streak Shields. You can also earn automatic Community Bounties (+500 Credits for verified/resolved bug reports on info.xernerx.com/bugs, +250 Credits for accepted/implemented suggestions on info.xernerx.com/suggestions), claim Contributor Milestone Achievements (Streak Master, Community Voter, Ecosystem Builder), and earn +250 Credits for both you and a friend via the Referral Program!

card4.title: How does the Media CDN (cdn.xernerx.com) work and what are the storage quotas?
card4.description: Every Xernerx account includes 10 Media CDN slots on cdn.xernerx.com (50 with Virtue/Zodiac, 100 with Xernerx Ultra, plus permanent +1/+3/+10 slot upgrades in the Credit Store). The Media Studio supports custom Folders, searchable #tags, multi-select bulk privacy/deletion controls, and a pre-upload Aspect-Ratio Image Cropper (1:1 Avatar, 16:9 Banner, or Freeform).

card5.title: How do I apply for open staff or developer positions at Xernerx Studios?
card5.description: Visit xernerx.com/applications (or vanity URLs xernerx.com/careers and xernerx.com/jobs) to browse open engineering, moderation, translator, and community roles, review requirements and benefits, and submit your application. You can track your application's review status and staff notes anytime on account.xernerx.com/activity and enable Application Reviewed alerts on account.xernerx.com/notifications.

card6.title: What can I spend Credits on in the Credit Store, and how do Credit Top-Up Packs work?
card6.description: Visit store.xernerx.com/?category=credits to redeem Credits for permanent CDN Media Slots, Profile Showcase Slots, Custom Vanity URL Slots (2,000 Credits per slot or 5,000 Credits for a 3-slot bundle for Users, Bots, Servers & Organizations), Streak Shields (500 Credits, max 3 active), 3-Day/7-Day Trial Passes, and Vanity Badges (including the interactive Dot-Matrix Profile Banner). You can also spend Credits directly on Bot & Server pages or dashboards to activate 24-Hour (1,000 Credits) or 7-Day (5,000 Credits) Community Spotlight Boosts, send direct Creator Tips (50–2,500 Credits), and review your full Credit Balance & Transaction Ledger.

card7.title: Can I tip Credits to other users or bot developers?
card7.description: Yes! Peer-to-Peer Credit Tipping allows you to send spendable Xernerx Credits directly to friends, community contributors, or your favorite bot developers from their public profile or bot listing page. Both the sender and recipient receive an instant ledger receipt in their Account Billing history.

card1.title: Which API namespace should I use (/v1, /core, or /secure)?
card1.description: Use /v1/* (docs.xernerx.com/api/v1) for external developer integrations—including bot profiles, statistical snapshots (@xernerx/stats), bulk slash command syncing (PUT /v1/bots/[id]/commands), live SVG badges (/v1/[entity]/[id]/badge.svg), leaderboards (/v1/leaderboard), and changelog RSS (/v1/changelog/rss). Use /core/* and /info/* (docs.xernerx.com/api/core) for public embed widgets, Discord metadata lookups, and public roadmap/suggestions/issues queries. The /secure/* namespace (docs.xernerx.com/api/secure) is reserved for authenticated first-party suite applications and tokens explicitly granted the secure (or admin) permission flag by an administrator.

card2.title: What are the API rate limits, CORS policies, and Interactive Playground features?
card2.description: Public requests to api.xernerx.com are rate-limited to 100 requests per minute per IP address (returning 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After and X-RateLimit-* headers; first-party *.xernerx.com traffic is exempt, and extended limits are available via Developer Pro on store.xernerx.com/?category=developers). Public routes (/v1/*, /core/*, /api/version, /api/changelog) include permissive CORS headers. You can test live API requests with your Bearer token directly in your browser using the Interactive API Explorer on docs.xernerx.com/api/v1.

card3.title: How do I embed live Bot, Server, Organization, or User widgets and SVG badges?
card3.description: Enable Public Embed Widget in your User, Bot, Server, or Organization Settings to unlock live cards at /core/[bots|guilds|organizations|users]/[id]—supporting JSON, HTML iframes (?type=iframe), SVGs (?type=svg), and PNG cards (?type=png), complete with active Vanity Badges and Daily Streaks on user cards. You can also embed compact SVG shields via /v1/[entity]/[id]/badge.svg (including status, ping, guilds, votes, and streak metrics) with 1-click Markdown/HTML copy from any Bot Statistics tab.

card4.title: How do I connect a service to the real-time WebSocket Gateway?
card4.description: Install @xernerx/websocket or test live and simulated JSON-RPC frames directly in your browser using the Interactive WebSocket RPC Playground at docs.xernerx.com/websocket#playground. For outbound bot webhooks, the Developer Portal (/portal/bots/[id]) includes a live Webhook Delivery Log recording the latest 25 deliveries with status codes, latency, payload inspection, and 1-click Replay.

card5.title: What features are exclusive to the Xernerx Desktop App?
card5.description: Download the native Electron client at xernerx.com/download (or xernerx.com/desktop) for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Desktop-exclusive features configurable in account.xernerx.com/preferences include: (1) Multi-Account Switcher with isolated Chromium session partitions; (2) Always-on-Top Live Overlay Monitor (app.xernerx.com/overlay); (3) Live Discord Rich Presence (RPC); and (4) Global summon shortcut (Ctrl + Shift + X), system tray mode, and customizable borderless window controls.

card6.title: What global keyboard shortcuts are available across all Xernerx applications?
card6.description: Every Xernerx Suite application supports global keyboard shortcuts: Ctrl + K focuses the page search bar or opens the Command Palette (Ctrl + Shift + K always opens the Command Palette), Ctrl + Space (or Alt + A) opens the App Drawer, Ctrl + . toggles the cross-subdomain URL Omnibar, Ctrl + B toggles the Sidebar, Ctrl + I opens Notifications, Ctrl + , jumps to Account Settings, Ctrl + / opens the Keyboard Shortcuts & Changelog modal, Ctrl + S / Ctrl + Enter saves unsaved changes, Alt + 1..9 switches sidebar views, and Ctrl + Shift + C copies the current suite URL.

card7.title: How do Token Lifecycle States (Pending, Active, Inactive, Suspended) and Elevated Permissions work?
card7.description: Tokens created on account.xernerx.com/tokens track live requestCount and lastUsedAt telemetry whenever validated via /secure/validate/token, and support 1-click Roll Token to rotate your secret key in-place without losing permissions, co-owners, or bound bot settings. Bots also unlock 16-tier Server Milestones (Servers-1..16) and Member Milestones (Members-1..16) displayed on bot profiles and showcased as Biggest Bot Milestone Badges on developer user profiles.

card8.title: How does the Open-Source NPM Package Documentation Reader (docs.xernerx.com/packages) work?
card8.description: Visit docs.xernerx.com/packages to browse official open-source Xernerx developer libraries and frameworks published on npm and GitHub (such as xernerx, @xernerx/framework, @xernerx/stats, and @xernerx/websocket). The documentation reader dynamically indexes every published semantic version and lets you switch versions via the Version Selector, inspect Classes, Interfaces, Functions, Constructors, Properties, and Methods, or use the global package search bar to jump to any symbol across all latest packages.

overview.title: Overview & Architecture
overview.subtitle: Correlated Request-Response RPC over persistent WebSocket
overview.description1: The Xernerx WebSocket Gateway operates as a private, authenticated RPC microservice daemon. Rather than exposing direct database ports or requiring external bot runtimes and dashboard instances to maintain direct MongoDB connection pools, client processes establish a persistent socket connection to execute structured queries and mutations.
overview.description2: The gateway uses a correlated Request-Response RPC pattern over JSON payloads. Every client message provides an arbitrary request identifier (id), which the gateway mirrors in its response payload to allow multiplexed asynchronous communication over a single connection.
